notes: v5.5 — the Clipping release: (1) NEW Clipping tab — paste a stream/video link (YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok) or pick a video file, and Aura finds the best moments ON YOUR PC (loudness + scene changes measured by ffmpeg — no AI account, no uploads) and cuts vertical 9:16 clips: you choose how many, how long, and blurred-background or center-crop framing. (2) Optional captions per clip through Whisper (your Groq key) in the caption style you pick, with an .srt saved beside each clip; Import + captions places a clip on the active comp at the playhead with its captions styled. (3) Clips are saved to the NaloxAuraClips folder and import into After Effects per clip or all selected at once. (4) ffmpeg / yt-dlp are detected automatically — if one is missing, the tab shows its one-line install command instead of an error. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
